user.title: Set up CastnCasa
user.description: Sets up CastnCasa in Home Assistant. New residents can then be paired directly from the integration.

init.title: Manage CastnCasa
init.description: Manage residents and paired CastnCasa apps.

menu_option_descriptions.pair_resident: Opens the pairing page directly from the CastnCasa integration and creates a one-time QR code.
menu_option_descriptions.presence_settings: Maps a resident to a Home Assistant person or device tracker. A person with the same name is detected automatically.
menu_option_descriptions.heat_settings: Thresholds for heating forecast and the adaptive reheating learner.

pair_resident.title: Pair a resident
pair_resident.description: Choose **New resident** for a person not yet stored in CastnCasa. After an app change, reinstall, or lost pairing, choose the existing resident with **reconnect** so the name, shifts, and Home Assistant entities are preserved.

pair_resident_qr.title: Pair CastnCasa
pair_resident_qr.description:
Scan the QR code directly here with **CastnCasa → Settings → Home Assistant → Connect to Home Assistant**.

![CastnCasa QR code]({pairing_qr_url})

To open it larger, use the [pairing page]({pairing_url}).

The QR code can only be used once and is valid for **5 minutes**.

presence_settings.title: Map presence
presence_settings.description: Actual presence always has priority over the schedule forecast. Without a manual mapping, CastnCasa tries to use a Home Assistant person with the same resident name.

data_description.presence_entity: Home Assistant person or device tracker. Leave empty to return to automatic matching or the CastnCasa app presence status.

heat_settings.title: CastnCasa Heat 1.1
heat_settings.description: CastnCasa Heat publishes recommendations only. The learner observes real reheating cycles and can automatically replace the fixed lead time after enough valid cycles. Real presence always has priority.

data.heat_learning_auto_apply: Automatically use learned lead after 5 cycles

data_description.heat_min_empty_minutes: Reduction is only recommended for empty periods at least this long.
data_description.heat_reheat_lead_minutes: Fallback lead time. It stays active until the learner has collected at least five valid cycles.
data_description.heat_comfort_buffer_minutes: Additional safety/comfort buffer before the expected return. It remains separate from the learned lead time.
data_description.heat_min_comfort_minutes: If the next useful empty period starts sooner than this, CastnCasa recommends keeping an already active reduction instead of heating up briefly. It never recommends reducing early solely because departure is approaching.
data_description.heat_learning_enabled: Collect real reheating cycles using room and outdoor temperature.
data_description.heat_learning_auto_apply: After three cycles a learned value is shown as a suggestion. From five valid cycles it can replace the fixed lead automatically.
data_description.heat_learning_target_temp: Fallback only when the heating target is neither currently available nor available as a last valid value.
data_description.heat_learning_room_temp_entity: Temperature sensor used to measure how quickly the building reaches comfort.
data_description.heat_learning_outdoor_temp_entity: Outdoor temperature is used to weight similar heating cycles more strongly.
data_description.heat_learning_burner_entity: Optional binary burner sensor. Burner start is stored for diagnostics but is not required for learning.
data_description.heat_learning_target_temp_entity: Heating number entity for the current comfort room target. Changes are adopted automatically for new learning cycles.
data_description.heat_reduced_target_temp_entity: Heating number entity for the reduced room target. The value is exposed for diagnostics and the last valid value is retained across outages.

abort.no_residents: No CastnCasa resident is paired yet.
abort.resident_not_found: The selected CastnCasa resident no longer exists.
